_meta.name: hiring_client_requirement_profiles
_meta.purpose: Operator-specific prequalification requirements layered on top of ISN RAVS baseline. Analogous to naics_map.json overlay model.
_meta.source: ISN public directory + public HSE norms; operator-specific values confirmed per contractor ISN account
_meta.note: All profiles are archetype-seeded (confirmed:false). Verify exact limits/thresholds in each client's ISN account before quoting; then set confirmed:true.

prequal_platforms: Chevron CHSEM / OEMS evaluation (major capital projects)
profiles.isn_grade_target: Avetta green (compliant); Chevron CHSEM approval on major projects. NOTE: Avetta uses green/amber/red + Safety Maturity Index, not an ISN A-F letter.

performance.emr_max: <=1.0 typical (letter of explanation if higher) - CONFIRM in client's Avetta profile
performance.trir_threshold: <= NAICS 3-yr avg (typical) - CONFIRM in client's Avetta profile
performance.dart_threshold: <= NAICS 3-yr avg (typical) - CONFIRM in client's Avetta profile

profiles.grading_flags: Turnaround/major-capital work triggers higher limits + CHSEM/PSM evaluation. One industry source reports a Chevron CHSEM major-project target of TRIR under 0.30 / LTIFR under 0.10 - UNCONFIRMED; verify against the actual site requirement. Insurance limits & incident-rate cutoffs are set per Chevron business unit/site inside Avetta - pull them from the contractor's live Avetta account.
profiles.source: Platform & HSE-MS framework verified via public sources (smartqhse.com Chevron HSE Contractor Requirements 2026; ehs.inc ISN-vs-Avetta-vs-Veriforce; safetyproresources.com Avetta/Chevron), Aug 2026. Exact insurance limits & EMR/TRIR/DART cutoffs are NOT publicly published - they live in the contractor's live Avetta/ISN account and must be pulled from there.
profiles.last_verified: 2026-08-17 (platform + framework only; numeric thresholds still to confirm from live account)
profiles.management_system: Chevron OEMS (Operational Excellence Management System), Contractor Safety Management (OEMS Element 8); ISO 45001 or a documented equivalent HSE-MS typically expected; submit 3-yr TRIR/DART/fatality history + OSHA 300A summaries + a CHSEM bridging document.
